system.overview: One or two sentences describing the system: what modes it runs, roughly where, and anything that makes it distinctive.

history.title: Authority Founded
history.description: The Example Metro Authority was created by the state legislature to plan and operate rail transit in the region.

history.title: Red Line Opens
history.description: The first segment of the Red Line opened between Union Plaza and Airport, with eleven stations.

red-line.name: Red Line
red-line.description: The Red Line is the system's original and busiest line, running from the airport through downtown to the harbor.

loop-line.name: Loop Line
loop-line.description: The Loop Line is a downtown circulator scheduled to open in 2028. It is not in the agency's feed yet, so this entry passes through the build whole.

old-town.description: Old Town Station serves the historic district and was the system's first accessible station.

harbor-west.name: Harbor West
harbor-west.description: Harbor West closed in 2003 when the Red Line was rerouted to Harbor East. Closed stations are not in the feed, so this entry passes through the build whole.
